          CRAFTING BOOK
          
Make your mark.

          

            Click or tap a top face to stack a block. Click a side face to build beside it. Switch to Mine to
            remove a block you placed.
          

          
    
            
  • Drag to orbit. Scroll to zoom.

  • Choose materials with the hotbar.

  • Undo also restores a cleared plot.

            Keyboard building
            

              Focus the plot. Arrow keys move the column cursor; Space or Enter uses your tool. X mines the
              top block. Keys 1–8 choose materials. Ctrl/⌘ Z undoes; add Shift to redo.
            

            
You can also choose X and Y below the plot and press Place Block.

          

          

            
            
Sort my build

            
Build 3–10 columns. Each column’s height becomes a number you can watch being sorted.

            

            
            

              Columns are read by Y, then X. Heights include gaps under floating blocks. Your saved build
              stays here while you explore the lesson.
